display.purpose: Compact product identity in the project bar.

title.purpose: Inspector section names, timeline heading, and compact controls.

body.purpose: Settings, tool names, and supporting interface copy.

label.purpose: Frame labels, values, project metadata, and compact technical labels.

shadows.name: paper-stage
shadows.purpose: Separate the warm paper drawing surface from the slate viewport.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Compact color, border, and background transitions on editor controls.

components.name: Export Button
components.description: The primary output action in the project bar.
components.css: .ds-export { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 35px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; color: #241f1c; background: var(--accent); font: 800 11px/1 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 130ms ease, border-color 130ms ease, background 130ms ease, transform 130ms ease; } .ds-export svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-export:hover { border-color: #ff9473; background: #ff8b68; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-export:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: A compact project or navigation action on the slate chrome.
components.css: .ds-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-secondary); background: transparent; font: 600 11px/1 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 130ms ease, border-color 130ms ease, background 130ms ease; } .ds-quiet svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: #50605a; color: var(--text); background: #34413f; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Name Field
components.description: An inline editable project title in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-project { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #94a29b; font: 8px/1.4 ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-project input { width: 180px; min-width: 65px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: #e5ebe3; background: transparent; font: 600 12px/1.4 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-project input:hover, .ds-project input:focus { border-color: #485754; background: #263130; } .ds-project input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Tool
components.description: The compact selected state in the drawing-tool rail.
components.css: .ds-tool { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 57px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 2px; border: 1px solid #704f42; border-radius: 6px; color: #ffe7d9; background: rgba(240, 120, 88, 0.12); font: 600 9px/1.2 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-strong); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tool kbd { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 5px; color: #899890; font: 8px ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Drawing Stage
components.description: Warm artwork paper lifted above the slate work surface.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border: 1px solid #e4e0d6; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(11, 19, 18, 0.24), 0 14px 40px rgba(9, 14, 13, 0.24), 0 28px 70px rgba(9, 14, 13, 0.15); } .ds-stage i { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid #5e8580; opacity: .6; } .ds-stage i:nth-child(1) { top: 8px; left: 8px; } .ds-stage i:nth-child(2) { top: 8px; right: 8px; } .ds-stage i:nth-child(3) { bottom: 8px; left: 8px; } .ds-stage i:nth-child(4) { right: 8px; bottom: 8px; } .ds-stage span { position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 12px; color: #84928a; font: 8px ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; }

components.name: Selected Timeline Frame
components.description: An exposure-sheet cell with a clear frame number and active playhead.
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; display: flex; width: 94px; height: 112px; flex: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 8px; border: 1px solid #9a634e; border-radius: 3px; color: #f4b49b; background: rgba(240, 120, 88, 0.1); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-frame span { color: #ffb99e; font: 9px ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-frame div { width: 76px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border: 1px solid #d9d5cb; background: var(--paper); } .ds-frame::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); content: ""; } .ds-frame:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
CelFrame feels like a practical animation bench: measured, tactile, and calm enough to keep attention on the drawing. The interface is compact working equipment, not a gallery or a marketing page. Ink-slate controls frame a warm paper stage; registration marks and exposure-sheet cues make the hand-drawn workflow legible.

The drawing surface has visual priority. Tools, brush settings, layers, and timeline remain close to the canvas, with clear separation provided by tonal changes and fine rules. This is a focused editor direction, not a claim that every professional animation workflow is already supported.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper against ink-slate work rails.
Vermilion marks the main action and selected frame; muted teal signals drawing and registration details.
Dense, compact controls use restrained sans-serif type and small monospace measurements.
Soft stage depth distinguishes the artwork from the flatter surrounding chrome.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve vermilion for selection and primary action; do not spread it across neutral chrome.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use monospace where users compare values or scan frame/project metadata; keep explanatory copy in the sans-serif.

rules.name: The Paper-Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep depth on the drawing surface; use color and dividers to organize the surrounding editor.

dos: Do keep the paper stage the primary visual anchor.
Do use the existing slate, paper, vermilion, and teal palette values.
Do use monospace for values and compact frame/project metadata.
Do keep playback and the timeline close to the drawing surface at every viewport size.
Do label icon-only actions for assistive technology and provide visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't use vermilion as a general-purpose panel fill.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, or decorative shadows to the flat editor chrome.
Don't let settings displace the drawing stage or hide mobile playback controls below the inspector.
Don't use monospace as a costume for ordinary explanatory text.
